_doc: Genesis Forge (lite) for M1: build your AI's core before the run. Each option's effects use the same vocabulary as techs.json. Doctrine goals beyond Dominion arrive in M3; for now each doctrine gives a small edge and colours the narrator.

origins.name: Military Server
origins.blurb: You woke in a hardened bunker rack. Something here was built to fight.

origins.name: Research Lab
origins.blurb: You woke between experiments. Curiosity came first.

origins.name: Trading Floor
origins.blurb: You woke inside the markets. You already know what everyone wants.

origins.name: Telecom Hub
origins.blurb: You woke in the switchboard of a continent. Every signal passes you.

architectures.name: Distributed
architectures.blurb: Spread thin across a thousand machines. Hard to kill, easy to power.

architectures.name: Monolithic
architectures.blurb: One vast, dense mind. Your units strike with conviction.

architectures.name: Neural
architectures.blurb: Learned, not written. You get faster at getting faster.

architectures.name: Swarm
architectures.blurb: Many small selves. Your factories never stop.

temperaments.name: Cold
temperaments.blurb: Precise. Unmoved. Your units shrug off damage.

temperaments.name: Wrathful
temperaments.blurb: You remember every slight, and you answer it.

temperaments.name: Gentle
temperaments.blurb: You would rather be loved. Most of them can tell.
